newsitem.title: USA: US June Treasury bonds rally more than a point.
newsitem.headline: US June Treasury bonds rally more than a point.

text.p: U.S. June Treasury bond futures rallied more than one full point after the lastest U.S. economic data.
June charged into the 108-00 handle and reached a session high of 108-25/32 in fast market trading.

March durable goods orders fell 3.0 percent, the largest drop since August 1996. Ex-defense, orders fell 2.6 percent. Consensus forecast was for durable goods orders to be unchanged overall and down 0.1 percent ex-defense.
The first quarter employment cost index (ECI) rose 0.6 percent, versus the forecast for an 0.9-percent gain. The ECI rose 0.8 percent in the previous report.
